body:
Faithful, real Bazel port of the existing Makefile's own source lists: MODULE.bazel/.bazelrc/.bazelversion, cc_library per package (common/audio/goldenband/render/world/ui, plus a deliberate two-target split for simulation matching the real server/lobby source asymmetry), cc_binary for apps/lobby (shank_lobby) and apps/server (shank_server + serverctl). Verified with a real bazelisk build -- both binaries compile and link, Bazel-built shank_lobby live-verified under Xvfb rendering the real lobby menu correctly. Commit 3dee65f.

⚓ ☃
title: Migrate SHANKPIT build system from Makefile to Bazel
